patterns.note: Full-bleed, high-quality photography and video are used as immersive backgrounds for almost every major content section, often with text overlays.
Headings are consistently large, bold, and uppercase sans-serif, typically rendered in white against dark, image-rich backgrounds to create a premium and impactful statement.
A consistent dark, semi-transparent overlay is applied to most background images and videos, ensuring text readability and contributing to a sophisticated, moody aesthetic.

The primary navigation bar transforms its background and text/button colors from transparent to solid black with white elements as the user scrolls past the initial hero section, while remaining sticky at the top.
Major content sections appear to reveal themselves with a subtle fade-in and slight upward translation as they enter the viewport during scrolling.

The site frequently reuses the hero's visual style, featuring large, full-bleed imagery with prominent text overlays, for subsequent content blocks, maintaining a consistent visual rhythm and brand feel.

technique_notes: The hero section utilizes a full-bleed video or large image with a dark, semi-transparent overlay to ensure high contrast for the prominent white text and call-to-action button.

The main navigation bar implements a sticky header effect, dynamically changing its visual style (background color, text color, button styles) from a transparent overlay on the hero to a solid, contrasting bar once the user scrolls beyond the initial hero content.

Content sections are introduced with scroll-triggered animations, utilizing CSS keyframes to apply a gentle fade-in and a subtle upward slide effect as each section becomes visible within the browser's viewport.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold, uppercase sans-serif headings (~3-4x body text) with a clean, readable sans-serif for body copy.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle for buttons and input fields, otherwise sharp for most layout elements.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy in hero and full-bleed image sections, becoming more balanced in content blocks and the footer.

standout: The site's distinctive use of full-bleed, high-quality photography and video with consistent dark overlays creates an immersive, editorial, and aspirational brand experience, making the content feel premium and exclusive.
